item.name: Update Tool Policy - Enable Collection Tools

request.description: Example settings update that enables collection search and document enumeration tools. Include the rest of the assistant settings required by your deployment when applying this request.

item.name: Update Tool Policy - Enable Verbex Search

request.description: Example settings update that enables the Verbex full-text search tool for an allowed index.

item.name: Update Tool Policy - Enable S3 Object Read

request.description: Example settings update for document-backed S3 object reads. The backend tool implementation must be present before this becomes model-visible.

item.name: Update Tool Policy - Enable Tavily Web Search

request.description: Example settings update that enables Tavily-backed web search. Leave TavilyEndpoint/TavilyApiKey null to use system-wide Tavily settings, or provide assistant-level overrides.

request.description: Enumerate redacted model tool-call traces for an assistant. Optional filters include toolName, traceId, requestHistoryId, chatHistoryId, threadId, success, denied, startUtc, and endUtc.

item.name: Delete Assistant Tool Calls By Filter

request.description: Delete redacted model tool-call trace records matching the supplied filters. Returns a DeletedCount payload.
Returns TraceId and ChatHistoryId when the captured request produced an assistant history row.
Hydrated request-history detail. Use the returned ChatHistoryId with the History folder to inspect PerformanceJson telemetry.
Returns safe global Tavily readiness counts. No provider names, endpoints, or API keys are returned.

Fetch the current configuration first, merge the fields you want to change, then submit a full AssistantHubSettings object. Configuration responses redact ExternalSearch provider API keys as [REDACTED]; submitting that marker preserves the existing key for the matching provider.

request.description: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time eval run progress.
OpenAI-compatible chat completion. Thread ID is passed via the X-Thread-ID header. Response may include citations when EnableCitations is true in assistant settings.
Chat with metadata filter to restrict RAG retrieval to documents matching specified labels and/or tags.
Chat request that constrains RAG retrieval to selected AssistantDocument.Id values.
Expected 400 when attached_document_ids is supplied but assistant settings have EnableDocumentAttachments=false.
Expected 400 when an attached document ID is missing, malformed, inaccessible, or not completed.
Expected 400 when an attached document belongs to another collection or tenant.
Expected 400 when attached_document_ids exceeds assistant settings DocumentAttachmentMaxCount.

Chat request for an assistant whose ToolPolicyJson enables tool calls and at least one tool. The selected completion endpoint must explicitly set SupportsToolCalling=true with ToolCallingApiFormat OpenAIChatCompletions or OllamaChat; AssistantHub stores those values on the proxied Partio endpoint using reserved labels/tags. Otherwise the server returns an assistant configuration error before calling the model. If assistant Streaming is enabled, safe named SSE tool progress events may be emitted before the final answer chunks.
OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint without RAG retrieval. Uses the assistant's configured completion endpoint.
